text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Transcript of high-school or college（The average scores should be higher than 70% and every subject should be higher than 60%. Or top 50% of NEET (for Indian Applicants).） 6.Application Form 7.Resume (personal and family conditions, study and work experience) 8.Guarantee Statement FOR studying program at Qingdao University *All documents mentioned above should be written in Chinese or English and should be an original or notarized copy.
